svg.title: Color conversion, chroma subsampling and hue
svg.desc: A: one orange pixel converted from R′G′B′ to Y′CbCr with the JFIF full-range equations. B: in 4:4:4, 4:2:2 and 4:2:0 every pixel keeps its luma sample while chroma samples are shared, giving 24, 16 and 12 bits per pixel at 8 bits per sample. C: hue drawn as an angle, with OpenCV's 8-bit hue values (degrees divided by 2) and the blue range used in OpenCV's tracking tutorial.
svg.text: A · One pixel, two coordinate systems
JFIF full range, ITU-T T.871 clause 7
H = angle of the dominant colour
